gas.singular: a gas flame on a burner
gas.source: Our wording of the record field fuel_state 'gas' (burner flames).

liquid.source: Our wording of the record field fuel_state 'liquid' (single droplets).

solid.source: Our wording of the record field fuel_state 'solid' (fabric, plastic and wax samples).

no_outcome.words: The tables do not record how this test ended.
no_outcome.source: These test tables have no outcome column.

unmapped.words: The table lists the result as "{raw}".
unmapped.source: Used when a table value has no entry below.

outcomes.words: The flame went out before the droplet was used up.
outcomes.source: PSI-69 record, approach: tests ended when the flame 'burned to completion, extinguished at a finite droplet size, or failed to ignite'.

outcomes.words: The droplet burned until it was used up.
outcomes.source: PSI-69 record, approach: tests ended when the flame 'burned to completion, extinguished at a finite droplet size, or failed to ignite'.

outcomes.words: The test ended in a disruption. The record does not say what that means.
outcomes.source: PSI-69 record, measured quantities: 'how the test ended (extinction, disruption, completion)', with no definition of disruption.

outcomes.words: The flame went out by itself.
outcomes.source: PSI-159 record, key results and measured quantities: flames 'self-extinguished' or burned 'until the flow was stopped'.

outcomes.words: The flame burned until the fuel flow was stopped.
outcomes.source: PSI-159 record, key results and measured quantities: flames 'self-extinguished' or burned 'until the flow was stopped'.

outcomes.words: No result is recorded for this test.
outcomes.source: PSI-159 table column 'Self-ext or flow term' holds '-' for these tests, and the record does not define it.
